name: Rooftop explosion
about: A locked-off plate of a man on a rooftop at dusk, relit to a rainy night, cut out, an explosion laid in behind him, the comp with the rain over all of it. Paint is set up, not made.

roto.note: Man in a suit · cut out on this machine for the example

light.note: A cooler night grade with rain over it

fx.note: Explosion · Kitchen's LTX effect, laid in behind him

comp.note: Rain over the explosion and the relit plate

paint.words: the tallest tower on the left
